system.name: Student-Informed Teacher Training
system.one_liner: Trains a privileged teacher policy with a student-aware KL penalty and aligns student and proxy student networks to it in alternating phases.

content.variant_note: four panels redraw the same three networks, one overview and one per training phase, with grey frozen parts and a single coloured loss arrow in each phase
content.argues: The teacher is trained to stay imitable: a KL term against a proxy student penalises roll-outs and updates the teacher, while L1 alignment keeps the student and proxy matched.
content.subject: teacher, proxy-student and student networks redrawn per training phase, with grey frozen parts and coloured loss and gradient arrows

lessons.what_to_learn: To explain alternating training phases, redraw one network stack per phase in the same positions, grey out what is frozen, and show only that phase's loss as one coloured arrow with its name below; an overview panel can combine all the arrows.
lessons.suits: Methods with several training or optimisation phases that update different parts of the same set of networks, such as teacher-student, GAN or two-stage training.

evidence: (a) We train three networks by freezing weights (grey box) and changing gradient flows (dashed arrow) in alternating phases.
Our proposed framework consists of three alternating training phases

summary: The paper trains a privileged teacher so that a student with limited observations can imitate it. Figure 1 is a four-panel method overview. Panel (a) shows the teacher F_T, a proxy student F̂_S and the student F_S as trapezoid networks over actions a_T, â_S and a_S, joined by a yellow Penalty arrow, a red KL-Div Loss arrow and blue L1 Loss arrows, with dashed arrows for gradient flow. Panels (b), (c) and (d) redraw the same stacks for the roll-out, policy update and alignment phases, with grey fill for frozen networks, white for trained ones, and one coloured arrow per phase named underneath: KL-Div Penalty, KL-Div Loss and Paired L1-Loss.
summary_zh: 论文训练特权教师，使学生能模仿它。图 1 分四个面板：(a) 总览，教师、代理学生和学生由惩罚、KL 和 L1 箭头相连；(b)(c)(d) 逐阶段重画网络，灰色为冻结，每阶段突出一条彩色损失箭头。
notes: The role of the square A is not stated in the figure or in the quoted paragraphs, so it is described only by its position between the encoder and the action. In (d) the arrow direction runs from teacher to student to proxy student. The meaning of grey fill and dashed arrows comes from the caption.
